title: chore(ci)(deps): bump actions/labeler from 5.0.0 to 6.0.1
body:

v6.0.1

New Contributors

  • @​aparnajyothi-y made their first contribution in actions/labeler#901

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/labeler/compare/v6.0.0...v6.0.1

v6.0.0

What's Changed

  • Add workflow file for publishing releases to immutable action package by @​jcambass in actions/labeler#802

Breaking Changes
